# DHIS2 Modeling

Chap (the Chap Modeling Platform) runs climate and health forecasting models, evaluates them and connects them to DHIS2 through the DHIS2 Modeling App. A Chap model is a train script and a predict script in R or Python, plus an MLproject file that describes them. It is evaluated locally with `chap eval --run-config.as-chapkit`, from the `chap-core` package (`uv tool install chap-core`), and deployed as a chapkit Docker image. A model developer does not install chapkit separately, does not run the chap-core `docker compose` stack and does not need `chapkit mlproject migrate`. Start with "Getting started as a model developer" and "Bring your existing model to Chap".
